capabilities: Style codeblocks and inline code with customisable themes and colour settings
Add codeblock parameters for titles, folding, line numbers, wrapping, and highlighting
Highlight lines by number, plain text, or regular expression, including multiple named highlight colours
Render markdown links and wikilinks inside codeblock comments and codeblock titles
Embed local and remote (GitHub/GitLab) files in reference codeblocks with line ranges
disambiguation: Not a code formatter or linter; it only changes how codeblocks and inline code are displayed.
extras: Lists plugins it is compatible with out of the box; notes that links created in codeblocks do not appear in Graph or Backlinks due to an upstream Obsidian issue, and points to a roadmap in a forum discussion.
problem: Obsidian codeblocks and inline code have fixed appearance and few metadata options like titles, folding, or highlighted lines.

relations.evidence: to match code runners from the execute code plugin
External references can be set to specific versions by finding the version of that file on github

summary: Codeblock and inline code styler that adds themes, line numbers, titles, folding, line highlighting, and local/remote file referencing in editing and reading views.
